description: List products in a category (GM platform or application) or tag (such as "global-a"). An unknown name is searched as words instead, and the result says so. Same shape as search_catalog. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: look up by catalog.ids. Example: {"tag":"global-a"}

catalog.description: UCP form. Unmatched ids are reported in not_found messages.

ids.description: Product IDs, SKUs or URL slugs.

category.description: Simple form. Category name or slug (GM platform or application). Give category, tag or both.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.

tag.description: Simple form. Tag name or slug, e.g. "global-a", "vin-programmed".

name: lookup_catalog
title: Browse category or tag
